notes: Only 32 of the 70 shortlisted papers are TE primary research: about half the shortlist is antimicrobial-resistance/mobile-genetic-element microbiology, reference-genome papers, or ATAC-seq papers matched on 'transposase', so the set holds 32 instead of 40. The kept set covers mammalian TE silencing (KZFPs, SMARCAD1, HUSH, m6A/YTHDC1/METTL3, tRNA fragments, SETDB1, the later-contested 6mA result), LINE-1 and ERV activity in development, ageing, cancer and neurodegeneration, Gag/ERV co-option (interferon enhancers, Arc, PEG10, DUX/ERVL), bacterial transposon-encoded RNA-guided systems (Tn7-CRISPR, IscB, TnpB), and TE-driven phenotypes (peppered moth, apple red skin); the last three kept (Arabidopsis centromeres/ATHILA, Arabidopsis epigenome diversity, apple genome) are peripheral and ranked at the end. It lacks piRNA/germline defence, plant RdDM and small-RNA silencing, Drosophila TE biology beyond Arc1, somatic retrotransposition in neurons, and human TE polymorphism/population genomics, none of which are in the shortlist.
